what: The Size Converter turns shoe, clothing and ring sizes from one country's system into others: US, UK, EU, Japan, Italy, France and more. Choose what you are buying, pick the size you know, and every equivalent size appears, with the full chart below and your size highlighted.
If you are not sure of your size, measure your foot length or a ring's inside diameter and the converter suggests the size for you.
uses: Buy shoes or clothes from a shop in another country.
Turn a friend's size into the system a shop uses.
Order a ring in the right size from an overseas jeweler.
Understand US C and Y sizes.
tutorial: Pick men's, women's or kids' shoes, a clothing type, or rings.
Pick the size system you already know, such as US or EU.
Pick your size from the list. The equivalents appear above the chart.
Your size is highlighted in the full chart, so you can see the sizes either side.
Open "Measure instead" and type your foot length or ring diameter to find your size.
features: Men's, women's and kids' sizes in US, UK, EU, cm and inches.
Women's dresses and tops, men's jackets and men's shirt collars.
US, UK letters, EU/ISO, inside diameter and Japan/China, US 3 to 13 in half sizes.
Suggests a size from foot length or ring diameter.
Shows ranges when a letter size covers more than one number.

example.title: Worked example: buying shoes from Europe
example.text: You wear US men's 10. Choose Men's shoes, US, size 10. The equivalents are UK 9.5, EU 44 and a 28 cm foot length. For a ring, a ring that fits with a 17.3 mm inside diameter is about US 7, UK N½, EU 54.5 and Japan 14.

tips: Always check the brand's own chart; brands vary by up to a size.
Measure feet in the evening, when they are largest.
Sports shoes usually need 0.5–1 cm extra room.
Fingers swell in heat; measure rings at a normal temperature.
problems: Letter sizes like M cover a range, so more than one number size fits.
The measurement is outside the chart
Try another chart, such as kids' or men's, or the brand's own chart.
Width and style matter too. Use the measurement helper and the brand's advice.
